title: Macna Cooling Vest Evo
features: Advanced cooling technology for high-performance riding
Ergonomic design ensures comfort during long rides
Durable materials withstand harsh weather conditions
description:
Designed to optimize interior helmet ergonomics and temperature regulation, the Macna Cooling Vest Evo from Macna keeps riders dry, focused, and comfortable across grueling saddle stints. Built with Hydrophilic Moisture-Wicking Core with Fast-Evaporating Air-Mesh Outer, it boasts an installation rating of 0.5 / 10 (Zip-in or standalone under-jacket torso wear).

Engineered for all-season comfort, the Macna Cooling Vest Evo from Macna delivers exceptional moisture management and skin comfort, shielding riders from biting wind-chill and summer humidity.
